prompts.prompt: Production game sprite sheet, transparent background, EXACTLY 4 columns by 2 rows, 8 equal cells, landscape 1536x1024. The attached approved Three Kingdoms game screen is the visual style reference. Draw ONE consistent charming chibi Chinese Three Kingdoms LORD (主公), about 2.5 heads tall: young adult nobleman, friendly assured face, neat black moustache and small short beard, black hair under a small gold Han coronet, muted ivory and jade-green ceremonial robes, vermilion short cape, gold belt and jade clasp, cloth shoes, hands near waist, dignified cute posture. Clearly a noble ruler, NOT Guan Yu, no long beard, no green warrior helmet, no child, no modern clothes, no giant weapon. Use the reference's delicate soft brown outlines, low-contrast handpainted watercolor, warm ivory/jade/red/gold colors. TOP ROW: four coherent walk cycle frames facing front-left three-quarter (see face), feet alternate left/right in a gentle walk. BOTTOM ROW: the same four walk cycle phases facing back-right three-quarter (see back and cape). Same body proportions, clothing, face and crown in EVERY cell, no costume change. All 8 figures same scale and aligned feet baseline at 93% cell height; crowns at 12% cell height; each fully contained in its cell, 12% clear horizontal margin, no overlapping neighbor cells. Empty background must be genuinely transparent alpha, no ground, no shadow, no color halo, no labels, no text, no UI. This is a production sprite sheet, do not make a character lineup of different people.

Production sprite atlas for a Chinese Three Kingdoms board game. Attached image is the approved exact STYLE and NPC identity reference. Transparent alpha background. EXACTLY 4 columns by 2 rows, equal 384x512 cells in a 1536x1024 canvas, every sprite contained with generous gutters, no cross-cell overlaps. TOP ROW full-body chibi characters in the soft delicate handpainted watercolor style from the reference, about 2.5 heads tall: cell1 the reference's blue-robed bearded strategist Zhuge Liang, gray-blue tall cloth hat, feather fan, front-left 3/4; cell2 the reference's orange and ivory dressed lady with dark hair and red floral hair ornament, round silk fan, front-left 3/4; cell3 the reference's green-robed Guan Yu general, tied hair, long neat beard and green robe, back-left 3/4 looking toward the other two; cell4 noble main LORD bust portrait, young adult ruler with short black moustache/beard, small gold Han coronet, jade and ivory robe with muted vermilion cape, friendly assured face, NOT long-bearded Guan Yu. BOTTOM ROW: four square-cropped circular game AVATAR portraits with pale ivory round background and simple narrow warm gold rim: cell1 blue strategist face, cell2 orange lady face, cell3 green Guan Yu face, cell4 the same short-bearded jade/ivory/red main LORD as top4. Portrait heads large and readable, centered with transparent gutters. Fullbody NPCs exactly match reference designs and palette, subtle thin brown lines, no heavy black outline, not glossy plastic. True alpha everywhere outside each figure/portrait, no ground rectangle, no text, no game title, no UI, no extra people.

Production architecture sprite atlas to expand the courtyard town surrounding the board in the attached EXACT approved game reference. Match its pale handpainted watercolor and gentle brown ink, warm ivory plaster, honey timber, muted red cloth, gray-blue ceramic roof tiles, leafy sage shrubs, upper-left morning light. Orthographic 35 degree elevated view with 30 degree ground diagonals, same as the reference. EXACTLY 2 columns by 2 rows on landscape 1536x1024, four separate complete isolated building groups, each well inside its equal cell, large clean transparent gutters. TOP LEFT: small Shu command residence, broad slate-gray blue pitched tiled roof, open red-brown timber veranda, ivory wall, two pale hanging banners with 蜀 and vermilion border, not a huge fortress. TOP RIGHT: the reference's wooden horse stable and brown horse, low sloping thatch and tiled roof, timber fence and hay bale, the horse is calm and in scale, small group not cavalry army. BOTTOM LEFT: modest single-story red-canopy tea/market shop, timber counter with ceramic jars and a short angled low plaster wall, complementary orientation to reference market. BOTTOM RIGHT: small courtyard pavilion with low gray-blue tiled open roof on slender timber posts, warm lantern and ivory courtyard wall, airy and open. Low-contrast architectural detail, narrow outlines, soft subtle shadow only at feet. Whole groups visible with no cropping, no neighbor overlaps. TRUE transparent alpha everywhere outside isolated buildings, no background, no ground plane, no color haze. No board, no UI, no game title, no modern buildings, no people except the horse.

Create one square circular game avatar portrait of the EXACT SAME main lord as the FIRST reference image (eight-frame sprite sheet). Match his face, neat short moustache and goatee, black hair, small gold Han coronet with GREEN jade ornament, IVORY robe with JADE GREEN lapels and RED cape with gold clasp. NO white fur collar, NO long beard, NO red jewel on crown, NO giant emperor hat, no change to character identity. Three-quarter front view showing head and upper shoulders, confident friendly nobleman, delicate handpainted watercolor and thin warm brown outlines matching the approved game reference (second image). Face fills circular frame, warm ivory circular background, single thin warm gold rim. Square image, transparent alpha outside the circle, no shadow or color haze outside circle. No text, no game title, no labels.

Generate ONE transparent full-body character sprite matching specifically the GREEN-ROBED NPC in the CENTER of the approved reference, standing between the blue strategist and orange lady. Do NOT copy the armored Guan Yu board pawn or top-left avatar. The reference NPC has black hair in a compact TOPKNOT secured with a small gold clasp, bare head (NO green cap, NO helmet), long neat dark beard, soft jade green scholar-general robe with narrow gold trim, dark cloth shoes. He stands in BACK-LEFT three-quarter view, looking toward the blue strategist and lady at upper-right, with one hand thoughtfully near his beard, relaxed friendly conversation. UNARMED: no sword, no guandao, no spear, no military armor, no large weapon anywhere. Same charming 2.5-head miniature proportions and exact fine handpainted watercolor/soft warm outlines of the center NPC in reference. Muted green/ivory/gold, no ornate armor and no loud gloss. Whole body fully visible, centered, feet near bottom, transparent genuine alpha outside figure, no colored glow/halo, no ground, no shadow, no text, no frame, no UI.
